name: wa-whatsapp
description: OWN-CHAT TEST example (p3a) - posting and post-then-edit streaming are ON, but only into this account's own chat (post_allow ['own']), so the test can never reach a third party. Documented, not deployed: policies/default.json allows whatsapp.send only to chat:self and chat:alerts, so a wider post_allow would be refused by the host anyway.

config._comment: The post-then-edit test: send a voice note of at least stream_min_seconds in the own chat ('Message yourself'). The first recognized segments go out as the transcript reply within seconds (header + an hourglass marker), the same message is edited at most once per edit_interval_seconds as more segments arrive, and the last edit is the whole text without the marker. header_tag makes the component's posts distinguishable from the Go connector's in the same chat. 'edit_streaming' in the p3a brief is this component's `stream_edits`; there is no second switch.
